_comment: A REAL Plonky3 range-check proof produced by the deployed zkp-postcard prover,
captured from repid_zkp_proofs so the cross-crate verify test runs against a
genuine artifact (not a mock). The proof bytes live beside this file as a raw
binary blob (repid-proof-79103.plonky3.bin) rather than base64 text so that a
64-hex secret-scanner rule cannot false-positive on the long uniform runs a
base64 STARK proof contains. The test base64-encodes the bytes in memory.
This is public-by-design data: the whole point of @hyperdag/proof-verifier is
that a proof + its public statement are shared for client-side verification, and
this scheme's honesty block declares the score public (score_is_public=true).
The proof is zero-knowledge over the witness; the statement is the public claim.
